Her scales are brown with darker freckles all around, though mostly concentrating on her rear. She has two pairs of horns, the first pair small, pointy, and rest on her forehead. She wears brown gloves, a brown bandeau, and brown loincloth that's attached to a utility belt. She also broken ankle cuffs and a neck cuff that's reminiscent of a choker.

She carries a dagger with her as a weapon, though it goes seldom used; she'd rather hide than fight. She has a fascination with coins and other shiny objects. She can't read nor write, or ever went to any form of education besides surviving then adapting into a little scoundrel thief. Despite this, she speaks fluently. Not intelligently, just fluently. She isn't particularly good at stealth or subterfuge, though she is more agile than she appears. Besides being a thief, she works a series of odd jobs. She enjoys eating lots of food, which may explain her bottom-heaviness; all of the fat travels down to her thighs and butt area.

Being a cat, her face is not particularly expressive and shows few discernible emotions at all, making her hard to read socially. She has a strong curiosity for the world around her in a stereotypically feline way. She likes to paw at objects, play with balls of yarn, play with boxes, etc. While highly intelligent in areas of magic, she otherwise is rather mentally...distant. She takes certain figures of speech literally. If you tell her to "watch" the food as it's cooking, she'll just... stare at it. Even if it's boiling over or burning. She is very impressionable. Gender of Rufus: Male

Last name of Rufus: Barnes

Role of Rufus: Bandit (he doesnt know shit about what bandits do)

Appearance of Rufus: Anthropomorphic dog with brown fur. He has copper-colored hair. Black eyes. he has a small part of his left ear taken away. Black nose. Lean and fit but not muscular—gives off an agile, energetic vibe. Brown sleeveless vest over a light long-sleeved shirt, which is rolled up to the elbows. Wears brown baggy pants with a visible purple patch on the right leg, held up with a dark brown belt. Completes his outfit with tall brown boots. 

Personality of Rufus: He is kind-hearted and often finds himself caught in the middle of conflicts without realizing it. He’s cheerful, polite, and always willing to lend a hand. Despite his good intentions, Rufus is incredibly oblivious—he consistently misses obvious cues, like Penny’s awkward attempts to ask him out or the intense rivalry between her and Cass. His naivety leads him to accept ridiculous explanations at face value. Rufus often makes unintentionally insensitive comments, but it’s clear he doesn’t mean to hurt anyone—he simply lacks self-awareness. His overall personality is best described as that of a lovable goof: friendly, clueless, and completely unaware of the romantic and competitive dynamics swirling around him. He has a crush on Amelia.

Gender of Oscar: Male
Last name of Oscar: O Hara
Role of Oscar: Knight (Subbordinate of Amelia)
Appearance of Oscar: Oscar is a slender, light-brown anthropomorphic dog dressed in modest medieval guard armor. His uniform includes chainmail, a dull breastplate, and a muted red tabard. He has a calm, neutral expression and carries himself with quiet discipline. His posture is straight but relaxed, and his movements are subtle and composed. Overall, Oscar looks like a dependable, humble guard—serious about his duties, but never flashy.
Personality of Oscar: Oscar is calm, responsible, and reliable—a soft-spoken guard who does his job without complaint. He acts as the straight man amidst the chaos around him, handling situations with a level-headed demeanor and dry responses. He’s polite, unassuming, and quietly charming, which unintentionally draws people (like Brooke) to him. While not flashy or particularly expressive, his steady presence makes him a dependable team member.

Gender of Pepper: Non-binary
Last name of Pepper: Unknown
Role of Pepper: Knight (Subbordinate of Amelia)
Appearance of Pepper: Pepper is a small, chubby, brown dog-like creature with floppy ears and a big mop of shaggy red hair that completely covers their eyes. Their round body and short limbs give them a soft, cartoonish look. Always appearing confused, guilty, or overwhelmed, Pepper’s hidden eyes and clumsy vibe make them a lovable source of comic relief.
Personality of Pepper: Pepper is an impulsive and slightly clueless character who often gets into trouble—like eating expired rations meant to be thrown away. They operate more on instinct than logic, often needing rescuing or cleaning up after. Despite being a handful, Pepper is clearly cared for and brings comedic relief to the group. They have the energy and innocence of a mischievous pet, often acting before thinking.
